name: The Storehouse Community Center (Seven Loaves Food Pantry)
hoursNotes: By online appointment only; distribution has typically run Thursday late afternoon and Saturday morning — schedule online or call to confirm current slots.
requirements: Appointment required (schedule online; show confirmation email on arrival). Eligibility based on TEFAP income guidelines; serves everyone regardless of ZIP code.
notes: Formerly The Storehouse of Collin County; serves 1,200+ families weekly. Services provided without regard to religious beliefs and without proselytizing. Also offers Joseph's Coat free clothing.
